grounding: The selected passages match original report sentences. Exact quotation prevents newly generated factual prose but does not guarantee correct grouping, category or latest state.
diagnosis: All ten items select kind conflict, although the record includes causes, inspections, technical decisions, work progress, quantities and coordination.
Several selections group report fields by position across rows instead of by a coherent concern.
The JSON grammar supplies structural constraints, but the prompt does not explicitly explain the output keys and all kind values. A schema alone does not teach their intended semantic use.
